description: Fork of exp428 (89.4M, 1.4983) with FROZEN vanilla unembedder transplanted from exp416 (vanilla MinimalGPT+RoPE 24K, 1.2530). exp416 has weight-tied head=tok_emb; we steal that [V, 384] matrix and freeze it as student's unembedder. Student trained with standard CE on next-token labels (no teacher forward at train time). Tests whether forcing student's D=384 representation into vanilla's embedding space helps or hurts at fixed compute (bs=16, 8000 steps).
